newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian serviceman shot in Tajik capital.
newsitem.headline: Russian serviceman shot in Tajik capital.

text.p: A Russian soldier was shot and killed by an assailant in the capital of war-torn Tajikistan, a Russian military spokesman said on Thursday.
Alexander Goncharov, a sergeant with Russia's 201st Motorised Infantry Division in the former Soviet republic, was killed overnight on either Tuesday or Wednesday, the spokesman told Reuters.
His body was found in Dushanbe's southern Sakhovat district in civilian dress with a pistol bullet to the the head, the spokesman said.
It was the third such attack on the division in Dushanbe in under a week, he said.

Five servicemen with the division were badly wounded on Saturday when their vehicle was attacked with a rocket-propelled grenade and assault rifles and a sergeant was wounded by gunmen on Tuesday, he said.

Dozens of Russian servicemen have been killed or injured in the remote, mountainous republic where they carry out peacekeeping duties and guard the border with Afghanistan. The attacks have been widely blamed on Islamist opposition fighters.
Tajikistan's secular government and the Islamist opposition signed an accord in Moscow last month aimed at ending four years of civil war.
